description: Create an invoice and email it to --payer-email right away. Without --payer-email, no email is sent. With --interval and --due-date-days, it also creates a schedule that emails a new invoice before each due date; when the first issue date is still in the future or the first due date has passed, only the schedule is created and the next daily run picks it up. Requires an owner-scoped key for an org owner and the Pro plan.

accountAddress.description: Account that receives the payment. Auto-selected if the org has one account.

allowFiatPayments.description: Let the payer pay by bank transfer. Defaults to true.

ccEmails.description: Comma-separated emails that get a copy (max 10). Requires --payer-email.

dueDate.description: Due date, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z). With a schedule, the first due date. Dates count as UTC calendar days.

dueDateDays.description: Days between each issue date and its due date. Requires --interval.

interval.description: Repeat the invoice on each due date. ONCE sends a single invoice on its issue date. Requires --due-date-days.

payerEmail.description: Email the invoice is sent to

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: invoices_create
